text_block_list.name: Ines Fan A
text_block_list.text: I heard Ines gets savage when you run with her! I bet you've never done that, right?

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, have you ever worked out with Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way to our next training session,
Ines Fujin
and I stumble across a curious
spat between fans.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep... And it sounds like it's over me and
Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll go monitor the situation from where
they can't
see me. If I wouldn't want to
add fuel to the fire
by getting involved.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
Silence, please. Moving forward, raise
your hand
if you wish to speak. Now,
without further ado...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
Let us officially begin the fourth "Would
You
Rather Have Ines or Ryan as Your
Big Sister?"
debate!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to present my pro-Ines
argument! For
context, I must roll the
clock back to a few days
ago...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew! See? There's nothing like a good
run to
clear your worries!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want to thank me with a gift?
Don't
sweat it! I had fun! Let's run again
sometime,
y'know, to clear our heads.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, I knew it! Ines's kindness and
humility are
on another level!

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Mrrgh... I would like to present my own
argument
in Ryan's favor! Now, this all
happened during a
workout session...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Look at your biceps... And
listen to
what they have to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's okay—I'm right behind you. I'll spot
you if get
into any trouble!

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan B
text_block_list.text: You must've felt so at ease! Ryan's just so reliable!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fan A
text_block_list.text: Why, you... Well I've been saving an argument that's gonna knock you right out!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yikes! I don't like where this is heading...
Time to
step in!

text_block_list.name: Ines & Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't fight!
Fighting is wrong!

text_block_list.name: Ines & Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Debate Club Students
text_block_list.text: Ines?! Ryan?! Wh-what in the world is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Guys, listen up! I get how you feel. I
really do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But fighting's not the answer. I mean,
Ines and I...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We get along like peanut butter and
jelly-elly!
And I want you guys to have
that same
relationship.

text_block_list.name: Debate Club Students
text_block_list.text: Eep! They're standing next to each other! I can't believe we're getting to see this up close!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Weren't you just about to fight
each other?

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh. Nope, this happens all the time!
Once the
debate heats up, we end up
getting pretty
intense!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She's right. When you two are the topic
of
discussion, we all turn into a bunch of

motormouths...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, that is reassuring... but, uh, I'm
feeling
pretty embarrassed about... all of
this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that Ines and Ryan's everyday
behavior
has captivated enough people
to inspire an
organized debate
community. ...I can see why
they might
feel a little flustered.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... These underclassmen of mine are just so...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Adorably cute!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it? What's with the
confusion?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Yep, not at all, not at all! I'm used
to stuff
like this!
choice_data_list: いや、動揺しないんだなって……
その、動揺しないんだなって……
choice_data_list_en: No, I was just thinking how unfazed you are...
Um, just that you don't seem flustered at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense, seeing how you've got all
those
years of big sister experience
under your belt!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeahhh. And as a big sister to these
girls, I
couldn't be happier. ♪ It makes
me want to repay
the favor somehow!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What do you think would be good,
Trainer? I
want to thank my adorable
admirers!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. We've still got some time before
training, so
why not! ♪
choice_data_list: お茶会でのんびりトーク！

text_block_list.name: Debate Club Students
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Would you like to come too, Ryan?
We'd
love to see you there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll come for sure. Oh, but... try to
keep the
compliments to a minimum,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, surrounded by members of the
debate
club, the two idols enjoy a
wonderful tea party.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Would that be enough? I mean, I'll greet
as many
people as you can bring, but...

text_block_list.name: Debate Club Students
text_block_list.text: You really get it, Trainer! This is the best present we could have asked for! We'd better make sure everyone gets to attend this one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, there are other members besides
you guys?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's great! Invite as many members as
you like!
No number's out of the
question for this big sis. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although confronted with an
unexpectedly huge
horde of members,
Ines Fujin meets and greets
them all with
a caring and sisterly attitude.
